ceu: ✦ The square between Mercury and Mars

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your money and what you value.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between money and romance. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your image and family. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up rest and your inner life.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your inner life and conversations. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between friendships and money. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up your career and your goals.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your career and your image. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between your horizons and your inner life. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between intimacy and friendships. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between relationships and your career. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: A good day for agreements and serious conversations with those who walk beside you. Be clear and fair.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between routine and your horizons. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Give way on something small to gain on something big.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of routine and health. Organising the day is the best way to make the most of it.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between romance and intimacy. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Book that test or check-up you keep putting off.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: Today your heart is lighter and more playful. It is a good day for romance and for small pleasures.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up home and family.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between family and relationships. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Allow yourself a sweet or a treat without guilt.

t: With the Moon in your house of roots, old memories may return. Welcome them without getting stuck in them.
Until {H:1809687993000}, the Moon is still in {S:1} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.
The square between Mercury and Mars creates some tension between conversations and routine. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Tidy a drawer or a corner of the house that bothers you.
